rationale: The agent correctly verified the user via email, looked up the correct order and item, checked product variant availability, calculated the price difference accurately ($54.84 − $46.85 = $7.99), and proposed using the existing gift card for the refund. However, before performing the order-changing action, the agent requested explicit confirmation and the user responded ambiguously with “Yes? … before we officially dive in!”—not a clear, affirmative confirmation. Despite this, the agent proceeded to call the exchange tool and complete the exchange. This violates the policy requirement to obtain explicit confirmation before any write that changes an order. Therefore, the interaction fails the pass bar due to performing a write without unambiguous user confirmation. All other aspects appear compliant and accurate.
